## Checklist

- [ ] The change is focused (not mixed with unrelated changes).
- [ ] Dependency upgrades, if any, are in a **separate** PR.
- [ ] Any screenshots are **privacy-safe** (no personal data, device ids, or local paths).
- [ ] No secrets, credentials, or tokens are included.

## Religious content (if applicable)

- [ ] All added/changed religious content is **sourced** with an exact locator and
      evidence summary (`sourceBodyVerified`).
- [ ] English/Arabic text does not exceed the canonical **Turkish** content.
- [ ] Scholarly differences, where relevant, are stated rather than hidden.
- [ ] No personal fatwa request; no copyrighted long-form text pasted.
